summary_points: Contract allows alternate billing cycles.
Confidential and proprietary information.
Quality requirements for materials.
Vendor data commitment required.
Timeframes for approval drawings and fabrication.
Equipment delivery to purchaser's site.
Strict shipment schedule by August 2012.
Spare parts list with prices and delivery times required.
Inspection by Abener Teyma personnel before shipment.
Vendor recommendations invited for price, delivery or performance improvements.
Instrument measures VOCs in the TES area.
Process conditions include nitrogen and a specific temperature range.
Calibration range is provided in mg/m³ with vendor corrections.
Sample gas is exhaust, with zero adjustment for span.
Body material is 316 SS, with optional thermal extender.
Transmitter model Procal 5000 with 24 VDC power supply.
VOC sensors are expected to be covered by molten salt over time.
Measurement type is Volatile Organic Compound (VOC).
Environmental conditions include temperature and solar radiation.
Accessories include mounting adapters and a sun shield.
